artworks.title: Charles I
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in a three-quarter view, captured from the waist up. The man has a full beard and mustache, with long, wavy hair that flows past his shoulders. He has a solemn expression on his face and is wearing dark robes with a large, white collar. He holds a piece of cloth or handkerchief in his right hand. To the left of the man, there is a smaller inset scene depicting a raised platform with a person standing on it, accompanied by soldiers and onlookers. Above this scene, the words "O horrible Murder" are inscribed. In the background is a simple setting. Below the main figure, there is a poetic caption in a stylized script.

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person from the chest up, positioned facing slightly to the right while gazing directly at the viewer. The individual has long, dark, wavy hair, high cheekbones, a prominent nose, and a distinctive mustache. They are wearing a richly adorned garment with fur trim, detailed embroidery, and a circular medallion hanging at the chest level. The background is neutral with fine lines creating an oval frame around the subject.

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the shoulders up, with his body slightly turned to his right and his face looking directly at the viewer. He has long, voluminous hair that falls past his shoulders in curls. His facial features are distinct, with arched eyebrows, a prominent nose, and a mustache. He wears a richly adorned garment, featuring a high lacy collar and a decorative patterned cape or robe with a fur texture. Around his neck, he wears a chain with an ornate medallion. The background is plain and framed in an oval shape.

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, facing slightly to the right but looking towards the viewer. He has long, dark, curly hair, arched eyebrows, slightly deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and a moustache with facial hair under his lower lip. He wears an ornate garment with a detailed high collar and a necklace with circular decorations and a medallion. The background has a textured pattern resembling draped fabric or clouds with lines and shading for depth.

artworks.title: Sir Aston Cokayne
artworks.description: The image displays a bust portrait of a man with long, wavy hair, wearing a laurel wreath on his head. He is facing slightly to his right with a neutral expression. The man has prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and notable lips. He is dressed in a draped garment resembling a toga with a bow on the left shoulder. The background features fine lines typical of an engraved illustration. Below the bust is an inscription framed by a decorative scroll, inviting readers to a divine feast.

artworks.title: William, Earl of Craven
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing upright and facing forward. His expression is composed and dignified, with distinct facial features, like high cheekbones and a slightly pointed nose. He has long, curly hair that falls over his shoulders. He wears ornate armor, including a breastplate, gorget, arm guards, and faulds. A white lace cravat is visible beneath the armor. In his hand, he holds a baton against his armor. A sword with a detailed hilt hangs from his waist. The background is textured and dark, with a cloudy sky on one side. Below the portrait, there is a decorated inscription and coat of arms.

artworks.title: Oliver Cromwell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene featuring a large tree with various figures engaged in different activities around it. The central tree is labeled "THE ROYAL OAKE OF BRITTAINE" and has a crowned symbol on one of its branches. The branches hold texts related to legal, religious, and royal concepts. The roots are being attacked by figures with axes. To the left, a figure stands on a globe labeled "Inspiration Diabolical," pointing towards the tree's roots. Surrounding the tree, figures are involved in laborious or violent acts, such as using ropes or interacting with livestock labeled "Fatted for Slaughter." Inscriptions on different scales convey a narrative about disruption and the defense of traditional order.

artworks.title: Dr. Giles Everard Seated at a Table Smoking aPipe
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated behind a desk. He is holding a pipe in his right hand and smoking. He has a full beard, mustache, and long, wavy hair. He wears a cap and a detailed coat with fur trim. On the table, there is an open book, an inkwell with a quill pen, a lit candlestick, and a second pipe. Bookshelves filled with books are in the background.

artworks.title: John Goodwin
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man shown from the waist up, facing the viewer directly. He has a distinguished facial appearance with a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, and his hair is largely hidden under a black cap. He is dressed in a dark cloak with a large white collar visible. In his hands, he holds a book titled "Mr. of Mask" in one hand and his other hand is slightly raised with fingers extended. Above him is a scene involving a windmill labeled "Error" with a rooster labeled "Pride" and swirling cloud-like faces, each labeled with words like "Pride" and "Error." The background has a minimalist landscape with sparse features, including a tree to the right. Text surrounds the man.

artworks.title: John Heydon
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in an ornate oval frame. He has long hair, a serious expression, and is dressed in period clothing. Surrounding him are scholarly items like books. The frame includes heraldic symbols, Latin inscriptions, and celestial motifs.

artworks.title: John Heydon
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait depicting a man seated and turning slightly to his left inside an oval frame with decorative elements. The man has long, curly hair, an oval face with a prominent nose, and a slight smile. He wears a high-collared garment with a decorative band or sash draped over his right shoulder. Around him are books on shelves, suggesting a scholarly setting. The background is textured with lines representing shadow and shading, and the border includes inscriptions and symbols.

artworks.title: James II as Duke of York
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in full-length. He is slightly turned to his left, with one hand resting by his side and the other holding a large, ornate cane or baton. The man has a solemn expression with defined facial features and long, curly hair cascading onto his shoulders. He wears an elaborate robe with intricate patterns and a high collar, a chain with a medallion around his neck, and a sash across his torso. By his feet, there are tassels and decorative embellishments. On a table next to him is a large hat with plumes, and above it, a framed shield or crest. The background is a dark, textured backdrop emphasizing the subject's rich attire and the symbols surrounding him.

artworks.title: Thomas May, Poet and Historian
artworks.description: This image shows a man standing from the waist up with one hand on his hip. He has a serious expression, wavy shoulder-length hair, and wears a dark collared outfit with ornate detailing. He holds a small book in his left hand. In the background is a geometric pattern and a laurel wreath above his head. The text at the bottom identifies him as Thomas May, Esq., aged 55.

artworks.title: Francois Missonne
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person facing slightly right, with their head turned towards the viewer. The person has a narrow face, arched eyebrows, a small mustache, and a pointed chin. They have medium-length straight hair tucked behind their ears and wear a broad-brimmed hat, a period-style garment with a wide collar, and an elaborately patterned jacket. The person is holding an unknown object. The background features a textured surface with illustrations of a crescent moon, a sun with a face, and light clouds. The portrait is framed in an oval on aged paper with handwritten text below.

artworks.title: James Scott, Duke of Monmouth and His Duchess
artworks.description: The image presents a full-length depiction of a man and a woman standing together. Both figures are facing forward. The woman stands on the left, with long curly hair falling over her shoulders, in an opulent gown. The man stands on the right, wearing a large coat, trousers, and a hat with a plume. The background is simple, with minimal detail, and the top of the image is inscribed with the text "James Duke of Monmouth and his Dutchesse."

artworks.title: Col. James Turner
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing and facing slightly to the left. He has a mustache and a full head of curly hair that falls past his shoulders, partly covered by a wide-brimmed hat. The man is wearing a buttoned coat with elaborate button details on the front and wide cuffs, along with a white collar. In his right hand, he holds a slender object. The background showcases a pattern of clouds. Text beneath the image provides a narrative about the individual.

artworks.title: Robert Turner, Herbalist and Astrologer
artworks.description: The image is a vintage engraving divided into two sections. The upper section shows a portrait of a man with long, wavy hair and a mustache, wearing historical attire. The lower section depicts three individuals in 17th-century European fashion, with the central figure being held by two others.

artworks.title: Sir Henry Wotton
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a desk with his right hand on an open book. He has distinct facial features, including a beard and mustache, and short wavy hair. He wears a formal robe with a fur collar and a large ruff around his neck. He sits on a decorative chair with a cushion. In front of him is a book titled "THE STATE OF CHRISTENDOM" with writing materials nearby. The background includes a curtain on the left and shelves on the right with books and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: William III as Prince of Orange on Horseback
artworks.description: The image is a vintage illustration of a young boy named Wilhelm Henricus riding a horse. The boy is seated sideways on the horse, looking at the viewer. He has shoulder-length wavy hair under a wide-brimmed hat with a flower. He is elegantly dressed in a long-sleeve coat, lace collar, knee-length pants, and shoes with ribbons at the knee. He holds a slender staff or baton. The horse has a flowing mane and tail, adorned with rosettes, in a rearing position. In the background, there are figures, possibly soldiers, with one holding a spear. The background shows a landscape with lines suggesting a field under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Worthy
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man facing forward, with a stern expression. He wears armor and has long wavy hair. The background includes decorative elements such as an open book, a quill, closed book, scrolls, and martial symbols. The man is framed within an oval, with intricate patterns in the background. Text and an emblem are at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Title Page to a Manual of Private Devotions by Lancelot Andrewes
artworks.description: This image features two distinct parts. The upper section shows an individual kneeling in prayer inside a setting with classical pillars and lattice windows. The lower section portrays three figures gathered around a fourth figure reclining on a bed, indicating a sickbed visitation. The setting includes bottles and a quill pen on a table. The text above the images states, "A MANUAL of PRIVATE DEVOTIONS with A MANUAL of Directions for the SICKE By LANCELOT ANDREWS Late Bishop of Winchester."

artworks.title: Title Page to the Bible
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a title page for the Holy Bible. The drawing features the text 'The Holy Bible Containing the Old Testament and the New' in the center. To the left of the text, there is an illustration marked 'Moses' of a figure holding a staff and tablet. To the right, another figure with a turban labeled 'Aaron' holds a censer. Above the text, there is an illustration of a coat of arms with a lion and unicorn, crested with a crown and a banner reading 'DIEU ET MON DROIT'. Below the central text, two decorative heraldic symbols are present within scrollwork. At the bottom is a view labeled 'London', showing an eighteenth-century cityscape with a river, ships, a church, and dense housing. The drawing includes intricate detailing with fine lines, creating depth and texture in each element.

artworks.title: Title Page to the Bible
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical book's title page. It features ornate architectural elements, including two classical columns on either side topped with an elaborate entablature bearing a royal coat of arms. Above this is a detailed illustration depicting the coat of arms with a shield, crest, and carved supporters. The central text announces the title, "THE HOLY BIBLE Containing the Old Testament and the New," and provides details on its translation from the original tongues and publication in London by "Charles Bill and Thomas Newcomb." The bottom section includes decorative elements enclosing a Latin phrase "Cum privilegio." The design reflects a classical and Baroque influence, showcasing grandiosity and intricate detail in book design.

artworks.title: The Compilers of the English Liturgy
artworks.description: Thirteen men are seated at a large table. The central figure is distinctive with a hat and ornate clothing, seated under a large window with an arched top. Each individual appears engaged in discussion or contemplation, dressed in traditional robes. They have different facial hair and headwear. Quill pens and papers are on the table. The background includes an elaborate window and heavy drapes. A list of names with corresponding numbers is below the image.
